hook.h1: Frontier AI that runs inside your walls.
hook.lede: We trained the Singularity Foundation Models from scratch. They run on your own hardware, fully air-gapped, so sensitive data never leaves and nobody can switch them off from outside.

scene.title: A critical flaw, announced on Monday
scene.setup: A ministry, 09:00. A critical flaw is published in software that runs across its internal network. Leadership wants to know by evening: are we exposed?

without.p: Rules forbid sending internal code or logs to a foreign cloud. The AI tools stay closed.
Two engineers read code by hand. Meanwhile the alert queue keeps growing.
The strongest cyber model is open only to approved institutions in another country.
Leadership gets a best guess. Attackers who automate exploitation do not wait.

with.p: Singularity Cyber, on the ministry's own servers, reads the internal code. Nothing leaves the network.
The model reproduces the flaw on internal systems and shows which ones are exposed.
Singularity General turns the findings and internal documents into a briefing for leadership.
Exposed systems are patched first. Prompts, files and outputs never left the building.

end.without: Exposure still unknown, and the data problem unsolved.
end.with: Exposure known by noon. No data left the building.

objections.q: What are the Singularity Foundation Models, exactly?
objections.a: The Singularity Foundation Models are AI models Singularity trained from scratch, not a wrapper around another vendor's API. The family has three members: Singularity Cyber for security work, Singularity General for documents, analysis and code, and Frontier Cyber for approved government and defense institutions.

objections.q: Can they really run fully air-gapped, inside our own datacenter?
objections.a: Yes. The Singularity Foundation Models run on hardware you own, in your cloud, your datacenter or a fully air-gapped site with no internet connection. They are sized to fit in your own server racks, and we size the hardware with your team.

objections.q: Who controls the model once it is installed?
objections.a: You do. The Singularity Foundation Models run in your building, retain no data, and cannot be shut off remotely by anyone. The weights are installed and auditable on site. Frontier Cyber adds a contract, an approval process and a full audit trail.

objections.q: How good is it next to the big cloud models?
objections.a: By Singularity's internal measurement, the flagship scores 88.0 on CyberGym, ahead of published frontier results. On general intelligence Singularity estimates 44 on the Artificial Analysis Index v5 scale: ahead of Claude Sonnet 5.5 (31) and GPT-6.1 Terra (38), behind GPT-6 Astra (52) and Claude Opus 5.5 (48).

objections.q: Why not sign a contract with a cloud AI provider instead?
objections.a: A cloud provider's model runs on its servers, so your data leaves the building, and access can be cut by that provider or by another government's rules. The Singularity Foundation Models run on your hardware, where nobody outside can switch them off.

close.h: Run a frontier model on your own hardware
close.p: Tell us where it has to run and what it has to do. We will show it working on your kind of problem.
